correctness.rationale: Height Q(λ)=Σ_i λ_i(λ_i+1)/2 strictly changes by added column minus removed column, giving unique minimum in each clique. Increasing transfers are indexed by edges R_i A_j of a bipartite graph B_λ for distinct size indices i<j plus i=j when m_i>=2. The induced higher-neighbor graph is L(B_λ): two increasing transfers are adjacent exactly when their removed columns or added columns coincide. Since B_λ is bipartite, its line-graph flag complex has a good star-cover nerve equivalent to the connected nonisolated B_λ core. For s>=2, E=C(s,2)+t and V=2(s−1)+[m_1>=2]+[m_s>=2] yield cycle rank r=C(s−2,2)+Σ_(2<=i<=s-1)[m_i>=2]. The unique λ=(n) contributes +1 through empty rising link, all other minima contribute r; χ=1+Σr. Published unrestricted wedge-of-S² theorem then gives integral rank and homotopy, without inventing new proof of the prior wedge theorem. Independently implemented integer partition sum and computed n=26 value 4480; finite table does not prove universal identity.
